abstract: Supernatants from activated leukocyte cultures and individual lymphokines and monokines were added to cultures of JEG-3 human gestational choriocarcinoma cells in vitro, and effects on cell proliferation were measured. Activated leukocyte culture supernatants, recombinant gamma-interferon, tumor necrosis factor, and colony-stimulating factor significantly inhibited JEG-3 proliferation. In contrast, high doses of both interleukin 1 and 2 stimulated JEG-3 proliferation. Low doses of B cell growth factor stimulated JEG-3 proliferation, whereas the highest dose was inhibitory. Further understanding of the effects of lymphokines and monokines on trophoblastic growth may provide important insights into immunologic mechanisms affecting early pregnancy development and tumor-host interactions in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
abstract_ja: 活性化白血球培養の上清、ならびに個々のリンフォカインおよびモノカインを、ヒト妊娠性絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3の培養に加え、細胞増殖への影響を測定した。活性化白血球培養上清、組換えγ-インターフェロン、腫瘍壊死因子、コロニー刺激因子はJEG-3の増殖を有意に抑制した。一方、高用量のインターロイキン1および2は増殖を促進した。B細胞増殖因子は低用量で増殖を促進し、最高用量では抑制的に作用した。リンフォカインおよびモノカインが栄養膜細胞の増殖に及ぼす影響の理解は、妊娠初期の免疫学的機序や妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍における腫瘍と宿主の相互作用の解明に重要な知見をもたらす可能性がある。
